api.afterMany: Random(seed), skip calls of nextInt(4294967296), then nextInt(max) 6 times
api.mixed: Random(seed), then one call per entry of calls: nextInt(max) for a number, nextDouble() for "double", nextBool() for "bool"
api.seededRandom: SeededRandom(seed) of lib/domain/replay/seeded_random.dart: its seed, then the calls as in mixed
